metadata.question: Were the water levels in Lake Kariba in December, 2019 higher than the water levels seen in December, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR (surface reflectance; has QA60 cloud mask) starting 1 Dec – 31 Dec both years inside Lake Kariba, Zambia/Zimbabwe. Only water-coincident pixels → QA >60% clear pixels. 2. Masking: QA60, keep only pixels where NDVI < 0.0 (water). 3. Water-level metric: mean water-covered surface fraction during Dec in each year. 4. If 2018 collection empty → C1, else if 2019 empty → fallback attempt (widen date or switch to Landsat 8). 5. After masking, if any year has 0 clear water pixels → C2. 6. Compute fractions; compare. If both valid fractions, A if 2019 > 2018, else B. Any None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # Geometry: Lake Kariba central part (avoids cloudy shorelines) kariba = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [27.7, -17.0], [28.5, -17.0], [28.5, -16.3], [27.7, -16.3] ]]) s2 = ee.ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S2_SR") def process_year(yr): col = (s2.filterBounds(kariba) .filterDate(f'{yr}-12-01', f'{yr+1}-01-01') .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA60').eq(0)) .updateMask(img.normalizedDifference(['B8','B4']).lt(0))) .filter(ee.Filter.gt('system:index', ''))) # keep only images with QA if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0 frac_list = col.map(lambda img: img.select('B4').gt(-100) # water mask is already applied .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=kariba, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('B4')).getInfo() frac_list = [f for f in frac_list if f is not None] if not frac_list: return None, 0 return sum(frac_list)/len(frac_list), len(frac_list) f18, c18 = process_year(2018) f19, c19 = process_year(2019) print(f"2018: {f18:.3f} (means {c18} scenes); 2019: {f19:.3f} (means {c19} scenes)") if f18 is None or f19 is None: if f18 is None and f19 is None: print("C1") else: print("C2") elif c18 == 0 or c19 == 0: print("C2") elif f19 is None or f18 is None: print("C3") elif f19 > f18: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Geometry: Lake Kariba central part (avoids cloudy shorelines)
kariba = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [27.7, -17.0], [28.5, -17.0], [28.5, -16.3], [27.7, -16.3]
]])

s2 = ee.ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S2_SR")

def process_year(yr):
    col = (s2.filterBounds(kariba)
             .filterDate(f'{yr}-12-01', f'{yr+1}-01-01')
             .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA60').eq(0))
                                 .updateMask(img.normalizedDifference(['B8','B4']).lt(0)))
             .filter(ee.Filter.gt('system:index', '')))  # keep only images with QA
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None, 0
    frac_list = col.map(lambda img: img.select('B4').gt(-100)   # water mask is already applied
                                        .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                                      geometry=kariba,
                                                      scale=1000,
                                                      maxPixels=1e9)
                                        .get('B4')).getInfo()
    frac_list = [f for f in frac_list if f is not None]
    if not frac_list:
        return None, 0
    return sum(frac_list)/len(frac_list), len(frac_list)

f18, c18 = process_year(2018)
f19, c19 = process_year(2019)

print(f"2018: {f18:.3f} (means {c18} scenes); 2019: {f19:.3f} (means {c19} scenes)")

if f18 is None or f19 is None:
    if f18 is None and f19 is None:
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif c18 == 0 or c19 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif f19 is None or f18 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif f19 > f18:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
